title: Muslim American Experiences Today
discussion_signal: Pew’s discussion highlights persistent discrimination and unfair media portrayals alongside demographic and political visibility, while noting differences by age and experiences of support or belonging.
linked_research_question: How do Muslim Americans combine growing demographic and political visibility with persistent discrimination and a polarized public image after 9/11?
limits: The post summarizes survey findings without full subgroup tables
